intro: A social worker resume that shows registration, caseload and the outcomes you helped people reach, without breaking confidentiality.
tips: Put registration and your area of practice first.
Give caseload and the population you serve.
Show outcomes and the programmes or partnerships you built.

basics.name: Maria Gonzalez
basics.label: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
basics.summary: Licensed clinical social worker with seven years in child and family services. I work alongside families to keep children safe at home whenever that is possible.

work.name: Arizona Department of Child Safety
highlights: Manage a caseload of 18 families, coordinating services with schools, courts and health providers.
80% of my families reunified or stayed together within 12 months, above the state average.
Supervise four new case managers in their first year.

work.name: Valley Family Services
highlights: Provided therapy to 30 families a week.
Started a parenting group that ran for three years.
